title: Inflated trade notional in price impact calculations
summary: _Resolved_  ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The `getDynamicTradePriceImpact()` function uses inflated value of `tradeNotional` when called by `openTradeMarketCallback()` or `executeAutomationOpenOrderCallback()` because opening fees, oracle fee, and builder fee have not yet been subtracted from collateral.
